jobs.title: Founding Recruiter (m/f/x)
jobs.description: 01 · Why this role exists Invest in Values. Produce in Freedom. Boost Europe. Behind every megawatt hour our clients save, there are people who make it happen. RIZM helps Europe's largest industrial companies – together around 2% of Europe's total energy demand – make their energy decisions with AI. Our agent RIZMO works as a digital colleague. But the most important colleagues are the ones we haven't found yet. That's your job. We're about 15 people today and growing fast. There is no recruiting playbook yet, no big HR department and no "that's how we've always done it". You'll write the playbook. Not as application admin, but as the person who shapes who RIZM becomes. 02 · Hi, we're Diana and Josh – we'll be working together I'm Diana, 20, I study civil engineering in Münster and I currently run recruiting at RIZM on my own, 20 hours a week. That's not enough for what's ahead of us, which is why we're looking for you. You'll be in our Munich office – I'm based in Münster and will come over regularly. Josh, our co-founder & CBO, comes from statistics and risk management and will be your sparring partner whenever you need one – for tricky candidates, for offers and for figuring out who we need next. 03 · What you'll do Build the team of tomorrow: Design our recruiting from scratch – roles, workflows, tools – and later bring more recruiters and sourcers on board yourself. Find the right people: Track down engineers, energy experts and product people via LinkedIn, Juicebox, universities, communities and your own network. Win people over: Lead first conversations, tell our story convincingly and make sure every candidate feels well looked after – even when it's a no. Make it smart: Automate sequences, screening and reporting with AI instead of maintaining spreadsheets. Steer by numbers: Always know where the funnel gets stuck – and turn the right dials. Get us seen: Shape how RIZM is perceived as an employer – careers page, job ads, events, university partnerships. 04

Als Talent Acquisition Manager (all genders) spielst du eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Gewinnung von Top-Talenten, während sich getolo vom Start-up zum Scale-up weiterentwickelt. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf dem gesamten Recruiting-Prozess für unsere Sales- und Operations-Teams. Die Position ist in Vollzeit (40 Stunden pro Woche) und im hybriden Arbeitsmodell zu besetzen. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn , X , Instagram , and YouTube . Job Description: We are looking for a highly strategic and execution-focused EMEA Talent Acquisition Partner to help scale some of the most critical engineering hiring within the company.
